title: Disappointed. A Pick-Nick Kit does not equal Tactical Gear.
text:
For over $100, I was expecting a lot more, and I was expecting tactical gear, like a first aid kit, or tactical pack. Instead, I basically got a pick-nick kit.

In the box was an insulated pick-nick backpack (there are $30 ones that actually come with dishes and silverware, while this one did not), a small pick-nick blanket (I've seen much better for less than $30), a cloth hammock (they literally call it a "hippy hammock", and would be about $20), a small ax ($20), a knife (I've seen these for $11), and a pack of freeze-dried biscuits and gravy (about $7). So, overall, worth about $118, which is just a handful of dollars more than I payed for it.

They could have at least had a camping hammock, or a tactical backpack. The fact that this box is themed around tactical gear, but I got a pick-nick kit instead, was really disappointing. I was expecting survival gear, not lounging gear.
label: negative
